topic: Analyzing frequency calculation and report discrepancies
summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on debugging and validating frequency calculation metrics using SQL queries. The initial discussion confirmed the correctness of a default frequency formula (`session_all_sample_screens/device_number_sample_screens`) across different data sources (device_session_agg_4 and device_session_agg_5).

A second, separate issue was raised regarding discrepancies between cached report metrics and live-generated reports for a specific campaign. It was noted that the system caches metrics to improve performance, requiring a special job to recalculate them nightly.

It was determined that if data staleness is suspected, creating a ticket for the responsible developer (Жека) is necessary to investigate whether automatic metric recalculation can be implemented upon report generation.
decisions: The default frequency calculation formula was validated as correct across multiple datasets.
action_items: Create a ticket for the relevant developer regarding potential data staleness and implementing automatic metric recalculation when reports are generated.
